offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and installs precast concrete products for highway, utility, building and construction markets, including barriers, sound walls, wall panels and utility structures. Also licenses its proprietary precast technologies to other precasters and leases barrier products. Produces in plants in Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina.

primary_products.value: precast concrete highway barriers; sound walls; architectural wall panels; precast utility vaults and structures; soil-retaining wall systems

primary_services.value: precast installation; barrier rental; engineering and design; shipping

customer_segment.value: B2G: state departments of transportation, highway authorities and public infrastructure agencies; B2B: general contractors, utility companies, developers and licensed precast producers

end_markets.value: highway and transportation infrastructure; commercial and institutional construction; utilities; data centers

revenue_model.value: product sales: manufactured precast concrete products sold to contractors and agencies; rental or leasing: barrier rentals for road projects; licensing or royalties: royalties from licensees using proprietary precast technologies; service fees: installation, shipping and engineering services
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: casts precast concrete from cement, aggregate and steel, sold to contractors and agencies; service provider: installation and shipping of precast products on job sites; other: licenses proprietary precast technologies to other producers

geography_served.value: US national: Primarily US East Coast and mid-Atlantic, with licensees and sales in other states and some international licensees

specialization.value: related lines: precast barriers, wall panels, utility structures, soil-retaining walls, plus licensing and barrier rental

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bid and negotiated sales to contractors, agencies and utilities; partners / resellers: licensees who produce and sell products under license

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state DOT product specifications, crash-test standards, environmental and workplace safety rules
